signal: Raised $45M to make AI model training usable by nontechnical experts. Ashby board is live, including Founding Recruiter (Sep 29) and Member of Business Staff (Sep 10), plus intern roles posted Nov 5, three days after the raise.
why_icp: They are selling AI to nontechnical experts and hiring a business bench right after the raise. That is a company trying to turn model work into a repeatable go-to-market motion, which is the buyer Sim describes.
suggested_contact_title: CEO or Head of GTM / Member of Business Staff hiring manager
first_line: Congrats on the $45M raise on Nov 2. You posted intern roles three days later, which usually means the business team is about to get a lot of messy workflow work.

signal: Raised $24M to build more AI-enabled geothermal drill rigs for enterprise buildings.
why_icp: An operations-heavy company already putting AI on field equipment. The next bottleneck is usually the office workflows around those jobs, which is where a knowledge-work agent platform shows up.
suggested_contact_title: COO or Head of Operations / CEO
first_line: The $24M raise to scale AI-enabled geothermal rigs is a good time to look at the office workflows around those jobs, not just the hardware.

signal: Raised $10M to make the digital world real enough for robots.
why_icp: Early robotics/AI company that will have to turn research work into customer deployments. A 10-person-plus team in that mode often needs agents on internal systems, not another chatbot.
suggested_contact_title: CEO or Head of Customer Engineering
first_line: A $10M raise to make simulation real enough for robots usually comes with a pile of deployment and customer-ops workflow still done by hand.

signal: Announced a $280M raise at a $2B valuation (TechCrunch, Nov 18). Site positions an AI financial controller agent for finance teams. Large, so scored down on stage.
why_icp: Finance teams are a classic knowledge-work buyer, and Payhawk is already selling an AI agent story. They may be a partner, a buyer of extra workflow automation, or too far along. Worth a careful first line, not a spray.
suggested_contact_title: Head of Product or VP Operations
first_line: The $280M raise and the AI financial controller story is a moment when the leftover finance workflows around the product usually get painful.

signal: Raised $350M at a $2.5B valuation (TechCrunch, Aug 26). Viral AI assistant, later-stage so scored down.
why_icp: An AI assistant company scaling after a large raise often needs enterprise workflow integrations, which is adjacent to Sim. Size is the risk, not the ICP.
first_line: A $350M raise around a viral assistant usually creates a backlog of enterprise workflow work that the core product was not built to run.
